title: Anthropic Messages response
description: Native Anthropic wire format, seen on the sdk surface (/llm/call/{slug}/v1/messages) and the Bedrock /anthropic/ bridge.

stop_details.description: Added upstream 2026-09. A structured companion to stop_reason; null on every ordinary turn so far. Documented rather than carried through: stop_reason is what the OpenAI finish_reason maps from.

content.description: Always an array of typed blocks, never a bare string. Flattening it to a string is a translation bug.

input.description: Unlike OpenAI's tool_calls.function.arguments, this is a decoded OBJECT, not a string. Translating between the two is where argument round-tripping breaks.

cache_creation.description: Added upstream 2026-09. Breaks cache_creation_input_tokens down by TTL bucket. Not carried into our usage triple: the flat counter above is the billable total.

inference_geo.description: Added upstream 2026-09. The region that served the request; informational, not billing.
